inlineSql: Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.IT_NAME As ItemNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL, B.GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.PR_CODE As PrCodeL,A.IT_TYPE As ItTypeL,A.TAG_TYPE As TagTypeL FROM ITEM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.IT_NAME
Select * From DM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND DM_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.DM_NAME As ItemNameL,A.DM_CODE as ItCodeL,B.GR_NAME As GroupL FROM DM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.DM_NAME

' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND A.BOOK_NAME IN ('WH SALES','TOUR SALES') AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? '

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,A.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,A.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,A.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,A.ITM_MRP as MrpR,A.VCH_SRNO,A.VCH_NO As IsuNoL,A.CO_YEAR As IsuYearL,A.CO_BOOK As IsuBookL,A.OLD_SRNO As IsuSrNoL From RATE_CUT_ISU AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.BOOK_NAME IN ('WH SALES','TOUR SALES') AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.SR_NO

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM SL_IDTL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND A.SR_NO = ?

Select IT_CODE,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END) As GrWt, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END) AS NetWt FROM MAIN_STOCK WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY IT_CODE

SELECT SUBSTRING(A.TAG_NO,4,LEN(A.TAG_NO)) AS TAG_SRNO FROM SRNO_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(A.TAG_NO) > 6 AND B.TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(A.TAG_NO,4,LEN(A.TAG_NO)) ORDER BY SUBSTRING(A.TAG_NO,4,LEN(A.TAG_NO)) DESC
SELECT TAG_SRNO FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' GROUP BY TAG_SRNO ORDER BY TAG_SRNO DESC
SELECT TAG_NO,SUBSTRING(TAG_NO,4,4) AS SrNo FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO <> '' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY TAG_SRNO DESC
SELECT TAG_NO ,'',0 FROM TAG_SET WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(TAG_NO) = 7 GROUP BY TAG_NO ORDER BY TAG_NO

Select A.TAG_NO From MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND B.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.IT_CODE <> '' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' AND LEN(A.TAG_NO) = 7 GROUP BY A.TAG_NO HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT TAG_NO FROM TAG_SET WHERE CO_CODE = ' ?
